scope: Read-only audit of actual catalog, chapter builder, installed families, disabled candidates and prior P2-021/P2-022 native FAIL reviews. No acceptance changed.

rows.subject: creature collapse and rest
rows.defect: Several fainted bodies remain upright or float above the grass and some resting poses do not settle onto the ground
rows.notes: The direct pose fixture needs confirmation in a real faint/rest transition; explicit hovering is visible in Trailpup and Veridian. Cloudreach resting Cloudfang Solmane and Tempestwing show clear ground separation in stills; flying faint states may have different gameplay rules. Phase 2c investigation: original compact baseline independently rejected in meadows/fixes/P2-015/baseline-judge.md. Current native capture was rejected at 1920x1061; queued fullscreen replay plus optional paired live transitions to distinguish terminal pose defects from seek/paused fixture artifacts. No visual fix or acceptance claimed.

rows.subject: creature hurt and movement poses
rows.defect: Hurt and moving frames often retain the idle silhouette so the state is difficult to read without a filename
rows.notes: Still frames cannot establish locomotion timing; check production transition captures before scheduling animation work. Tidewake and Stormwood stills confirm the recurring state-read gap; judge motion before assigning animation timing.

rows.subject: open terrain
rows.defect: Broad level grass fields and sparse ordinary trees dominate Cloudreach views where layered elevated land and ledge detail should lead the route
rows.notes: Deferred: paired native review FAIL requires a broader middle-ground scene redesign; no passing presentation-only fix established. Owner: Cloudreach scene lane. Skyline candidate remains off; evidence cloudreach/p2-021/paired-visual-judge.md (20 matched pairs; Bar A No / Bar B No). Matrix rows16/18 obstructed and rows17/18 resolve lower ground; no gameplay-fall claim.

rows.subject: map
rows.defect: The map canvas shows headings and markers without visible terrain or road context for the displayed destinations
rows.notes: First Shore is marked discovered but the Day 1 state may hide survey detail; both biome maps lack terrain/route context at this state.

rows.subject: normal creature scale
rows.defect: Several normal creatures read visibly shorter than the trainer in the shared near-framed scale view
rows.notes: Apparent visual height varies with perspective and posture; compare with declared size and a level camera before adjusting assets. Stormwood near-framed size comparison confirms this in five additional species. Cloudreach smaller species remain below trainer size in the common stage; exact authored scale versus perspective needs verification.

rows.subject: shiny creature finish
rows.defect: Several shiny variants become near-uniform hot magenta and lose their ordinary species material and pattern identity
rows.notes: Variants are easy to identify; Ripplet and Mosshell retain more form detail. Phase 2c: thirteen source-preserving regional shiny repaints staged at21a8e11de behind phase2_shiny_finish_enabled=false; scope/reset tests pass and independent code review found no baseline regression. Production paired sightings and blind verdict still required; no fix/PASS claimed.

rows.subject: ground pickup identity
rows.defect: Many unrelated ground pickups share small glowing plants, orbs or generic crates, so their item identity is difficult to read at normal camera distance
rows.notes: Code-blind ground-level review across four biomes. Meadows candies/potions are small colored glows; Tidewake repeats a crate family; Cloudreach potion/revive can read as flowers; five progression-gated pickups were reshot at authored positions with in-memory upper-route flags, and two TM pickups remain visually generic glowing orbs. All 17 chapter-gated ordinary Stormwood pickups were reshot with in-memory flags: potions/tonics share luminous plants, orb tiers/TMs share spheres, and boots/leggings look like tiny glowing tokens rather than gear. Three Stormwood story rewards are event grants, not world pickups. Two additional Cloudreach TM art/scale views use disclosed temporary staging on clear terrain; both are generic, nearly identical glowing orbs, and these views do not establish authored placement or accessibility.

rows.subject: summit aviary
rows.defect: The summit landmark reads as a small skeletal dome on grass beside a separate court instead of a layered stone sanctuary and its night silhouette stays dark
rows.notes: Deferred: fresh paired native review FAIL; crown arches do not resolve the whole-site skeletal silhouette or cold dark entry. Owner: Cloudreach architecture/art lane. Crown candidate remains off. Evidence: cloudreach/p2-022/paired-visual-judge.md; full 37-row before/after matrix plus four matched summit views; Bars A/B No. A broader tiered sanctuary and lighting pass is required. Original evidence: A recognizable distance marker exists but the hero structure is visually thin in approach and close views.

rows.subject: architectural landmark read
rows.defect: Several Cloudreach destinations present sparse plain or disconnected structures with weak landmark-specific detail
rows.notes: Deferred: Fresh regional native review confirms weak observatory identity and unusable beacon/High Roost ensemble views. Separate landmark redesigns and corrected authored views remain required; no accepted presentation candidate exists. Owner: Cloudreach architecture/art lane. Evidence and next work: cloudreach/p2-024/disposition.md. Original evidence: Usable approach frames support this; close observatory captures are pressed against the wall and should be reshot. Flight Aerie route/vista also lacks a recognizable built silhouette; route sampling may face away, so verify with authored approach. Stormward close views show isolated short walls, flat banners, detached cobble insets and a suspended emblem; its authored stand is usable.

rows.subject: menu shell
rows.defect: The full-screen charcoal menu with thin teal borders has little visual hierarchy or scenic connection to the illustrated world
rows.notes: Same full-screen shell in Meadows and Tidewake production UI; assess Cloudreach and Stormwood before final shared exposure.

rows.subject: secondary menu panels
rows.defect: The Quests Build and Players panels leave most of their area empty around a few plain text lines or a single button
rows.notes: The Day 1 fixture may explain empty panels, but the screen leaves large dead areas. Skills capture still resembles Quests; verify navigation.

rows.subject: exposed landform edges
rows.defect: Floating island undersides form blunt dark slabs and several cliffs and grassy shelves have conspicuous straight extruded edges
rows.notes: Deferred: Fresh regional native review confirms abrupt cliff/terrace joins. Shared mesa generation already has wall jitter and selective airborne roots, so multiple visual geometry roles need revision while preserving carved route crowns; no accepted geometry fix exists. Owner: Cloudreach terrain-art lane; gameplay owner for crown/collision changes. Evidence and next work: cloudreach/p2-023/disposition.md. Original evidence: Grouped as one recurring exposed-edge geometry defect; inspect whether cliff and island meshes share an authoring path.

rows.subject: craft recipe text
rows.defect: Long recipe names and material preview lines are clipped in the crafting list
rows.notes: Fixed in 54b189254. Enabled crafting UI passed independent code-blind review in Meadows Cloudreach Stormwood at 1920x1080 and four Meadows 1280x720 stress pairs; baseline failed. Current-main import and default/baseline controller smoke passed. Evidence: meadows/fixes/P2-095/accepted-ui-comparison/blind-verdict.md. Regional Bars A/B remain open.

rows.subject: catch effect finish
rows.defect: The catch sequence uses a dominant saturated magenta ground ring and flat bright orb that lose depth beside the creatures, with little visible change between rest and shake frames
rows.notes: Resting and shaking stills have little visible difference; motion and audio need separate review before judging shake timing. Tidewake normal fight repeats the flat yellow orb/magenta ring; rest and shake differ mainly by a small symbol, so the suspense beat is weak in stills. Stormwood dark ground gives more contrast, but the gold disc and magenta ring still dominate the rest/shake beat. Cloudreach tight overhead strike crops the target and makes the orb read as a bright puck; sighting merged after code-blind review.

rows.subject: exploration HUD
rows.defect: The many dark boxed HUD panels and outlined text occupy a large share of the exploration view
rows.notes: Tidewake exterior confirms the large team strip quest box quick bar and shortcut bar; Meadows frame is indoors. Cloudreach flight frames show the same panels crowding airborne scenery. Coverage question: a pinned Tidewake build-system render found no production BuildPlacer; camp/bed/build/craft world views remain open pending a valid Tidewake path.

rows.subject: bright Cloudreach route markers
rows.defect: Saturated cyan posts rings and rails at the bridge and flight aerie compete with the built landmarks while the launch platform adds a bright flat yellow pointer
rows.notes: Deferred: Fresh native review narrows the bridge criticism to conspicuous cyan accents; architecture remains primary. Aerie views are obstructed or omit the landmark, so a family-wide material change is not supported yet. Owner: Cloudreach scene/material lane. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-053/disposition.md. Original evidence: Both bridge and aerie show similar saturated guide geometry. Whether all markers share one asset or several requires confirmation; scored once as the recurring marker family.

rows.subject: fight team roster contrast
rows.defect: The left team roster fades to pale low-contrast text against terrain during active combat
rows.notes: Contrast varies by battle state; the roster is darker and legible at hit-001_22. Code-blind review. Stormwood team names likewise disappear into dense wet grass during tells. Full Venn run shows TEAM 5/5 while two entries are labeled KO; confirm whether the count means roster slots or active members before treating it as a defect. Cloudreach captain fight repeats low roster contrast against pale arena paving while health and status are relevant. Phase 2c: repeated combat pins restart the reveal tween every frame; default-off combat_roster_visual.json candidate preserves the running reveal. Live initialized-tree regression passed208assertions including unpin/re-pin and disabled/exploration controls. All regional fight sightings still need paired native review; no fix/PASS claimed.

rows.subject: shiny palette distinction
rows.defect: Some shiny variants have no reliably readable colour-block difference from their normal form at the device view
rows.notes: Other species have strong shiny distinctions; assess these pairs at the same lighting and camera.

rows.subject: grass and stone finish
rows.defect: Tall grass intrudes through shrine paving while repeated grass and simple stone surfaces reduce close-range material distinction across sites
rows.notes: Deferred: The shrine close-view fixture is wall-obstructed and lower resolved stands confound the paving claim. A corrected on-surface view is required before editing grass exclusions; the broader ground/material finish remains rejected by the regional judge. Owner: Cloudreach ground-cover/material lane. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-025/disposition.md. Original evidence: The shrine close frame is partly wall-obstructed but grass intersection is visible; confirm on a corrected stand.

rows.subject: settings and binding instructions
rows.defect: Dense gray-on-navy control instructions and literal key labels make settings and quick binding text hard to scan
rows.notes: Shared menu presentation in two biomes; [Minus] and [Equal] labels are visible in map instructions.

rows.subject: named NPC post readability
rows.defect: Several named Cloudreach NPCs look small or partly hidden behind the foreground trainer and nearby buildings, with little visible pose or costume detail to communicate their role
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude NPC interaction owner: four-angle evidence shows post obstruction, but ordinary interaction framing is not established. Confirm the real interaction before moving a post or changing camera behavior. Original evidence: Four-angle reshoot verifies the mustard-clad bearded Iven world model matches his portrait. East hides all but a sliver; north hides him behind the house; south and west show him behind or beside the trainer. The south view also includes a near roof wedge. This supports post/camera obstruction, not a missing or mismatched NPC. Dialogue text and portrait remain legible. Normal interaction framing still needs confirmation.

rows.subject: map active region
rows.defect: The current region map heading is shown while the Meadows region tab appears more active than the displayed biome tab
rows.notes: Source confirms the displayed realm is disabled, formerly using unavailable-gray styling despite valid selection. Candidate d68213708 gives only the selected disabled button bright text and a teal outline; realm/focus/input behavior and map canvas/zoom are preserved. Meadows explicitly handed off this narrow file scope. Independent source review is clean; theme margins/radii and row rebuild cadence are preserved. MAP-01 source 0930716ac supplies six native boots and 24 actual 1920x1080 frames with explicit Meadows/production-realm cycle metadata; only the local gate differs before/after. Independent code-blind visual PASS and strict catalog recheck PASS across Tidewake, Stormwood and Cloudreach. Enabled by 8c5009e09; prior and actual enabled realm-view tests each pass 8/36 with no errors. See tidewake/fixes/P2-032/map-01-{validation,visual-judge}.md. Stills do not prove physical input or persistence; broader map defects and chapter bars remain outside this item acceptance.

rows.subject: catch result hierarchy
rows.defect: Catch breakout and success text compete with persistent creature cards, actions and nearby same-species bodies, making the captured individual and outcome focus hard to distinguish
rows.notes: The breakout and success wording is clear but the caught individual and inventory destination are not visually prominent in these stills. Tidewake verdict wording is legible, but its caught banner overlays a full-size standing Cannonback while another Cannonback was visible in the aim frames; the images do not prove the caught individual remained. Stormwood success text reads Caught Voltwig and Put Voltwig away while a full-size standing Voltwig fills the scene; the visual transition from orb to companion is unclear. Cloudreach breakout and Caught Skyrill words are clear, but the caught individual is difficult to follow from impact through the full-party choice panel.

rows.subject: flight and landing pose read
rows.defect: Flight retains a similar spread-wing silhouette in air and the grounded return shows no bird or perch pose so the descent-to-rest change reads as a cut
rows.notes: Deferred to shared Fly gameplay/Claude owner with Cloudreach animation support: original stills/source audit predate owned-carrier Fly. Main cf0a3b974 now conditionally restores the recalled owned follower after freeing the flight visual; loaner teardown is distinct. Dense normal-input landing beats for both paths still need visual judgment. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-069/disposition.md. Original evidence: Code-blind verdict: trainer is clearly airborne then grounded but no foot-contact wing-fold separation or resting bird pose is visible. The two grounded frames are near identical. Stills cannot establish whether a transition animation occurs between captures; capture tighter landing beats before assigning animation work. Tidewake launch and glide silhouettes differ mainly by scale while boots stay near the grass; landing shows no carrier. Meadows elevated fixture proves high glide and grounded return but no visible touchdown. Meadows launch was reshot with the camera settled and now shows both carrier and trainer. Still frames do not prove transition timing. Stormwood fixture launch/glide barely distinguish phases in stills, and landed frame shows no carrier; canopy flag fixture does not prove campaign reachability.

rows.subject: dialogue foreground composition
rows.defect: The foreground player or nearby posts hide much of the named speaker in several conversation frames
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude dialogue-camera owner: phase2_capture_dialogue directly calls panel.start after a staged view. Reproduce normal NPC interaction before treating its foreground composition as a runtime camera defect. Original evidence: Code-blind review; direct-start post and post-win fixtures. Voss also distant and uncertain. All text panels legible. Normal interaction reproduction needed.

rows.subject: placed wall visual
rows.defect: A placed wall reads as a featureless cream rectangle with only a thin wood strip at its top
rows.notes: Visual-only production BuildPlacer fixture; one wall and floor placement at an open Meadows stand. No build validation or cost demonstrated. Cloudreach visual-only fixture repeats this presentation. Stormwood code-blind system view repeats this issue.

rows.subject: craft action hint contrast
rows.defect: Craft and leave button hints are faint gray on the dark translucent craft panel
rows.notes: Fixed in 54b189254. Enabled crafting UI passed independent code-blind review in Meadows Cloudreach Stormwood at 1920x1080 and four Meadows 1280x720 stress pairs; baseline failed. Current-main import and default/baseline controller smoke passed. Evidence: meadows/fixes/P2-095/accepted-ui-comparison/blind-verdict.md. Regional Bars A/B remain open.

rows.subject: dialogue speaker visibility
rows.defect: Named speaker is absent from the visible world view while the portrait and dialogue line remain on screen
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude dialogue-camera owner: direct-start initial/post-win fixtures do not establish ordinary speaker visibility. A normal interaction repro is required before changing camera or NPC placement. Original evidence: Code-blind review in both initial and post-win direct-start fixtures; Veyra absent from world view. Normal interaction reproduction required before assigning a runtime defect.

rows.subject: Cloudreach map region label
rows.defect: The discovered Cloudreach Gate / Lower Cliffs label is cut after LOWER without a wrap or ellipsis
rows.notes: Deferred: The clipped discovered-region label requires a shared map-callout layout change and device-profile verification across long labels and zoom states. No independently judged layout fix is available in this lane. Owner: Shared map UI lane, with Cloudreach label coverage. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-048/disposition.md. Original evidence: The exploration HUD spells the full location at the same initial state; the map strip truncates it.

rows.subject: floating dark strips
rows.defect: Disconnected black rail-like strips cross grass and extend into open air above the Cloudreach void
rows.notes: Deferred: A fresh native Aerie review still sees a detached dark strip, but its owning geometry is not identified and the Stormward original stand has not been matched. Deleting or moving an assumed prop would not be an evidence-backed fix. Owner: Cloudreach scene/prop lane. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-049/disposition.md. Original evidence: Clearly visible in the Stormward route frame; a second distant sighting may be the same prop family. Confirm from an authored stand.

rows.subject: mushroom pickup variants
rows.defect: Speed Mushroom and Wild Mushroom use the same pale yellow mushroom cluster silhouette at normal camera distance
rows.notes: Deferred: Source audit finds inconsistent mushroom dressing between BandPickups and ItemCachePickup. A shared, texture-preserving variant treatment still needs matched production-camera proof; changing the common mesh globally would affect all three mushroom items. Owner: Cloudreach-owned shared pickup presentation lane. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-054/disposition.md. Original evidence: Both named item subjects are clearly visible in full-resolution production-camera captures.

rows.subject: High Perches rim mushroom
rows.defect: A yellow mushroom cluster appears suspended beyond the grassy rim with no ground beneath its stem
rows.notes: Deferred: The rim view does not establish whether the pickup is supported by a hidden lower ledge. Pickup surface/depth validation is required before changing a functional world-item position. Owner: Cloudreach gameplay placement owner, with scene-art verification. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-102/disposition.md. Original evidence: Visible in the production-camera rim views; placement could be on a hidden lower ledge, so verify side depth before moving.

rows.subject: mounted terrace edge and cloud crossing
rows.defect: The mounted deer and seated trainer retain their upright riding silhouette while travelling below the cliff and then continue apparently unsupported across the cloud floor
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude traversal owner: the capture deliberately drives a mount off a terrace; grounded collision and recovery must be validated before assigning a pose defect. Collision/traversal-state changes are outside this visual lane. Original evidence: Capture deliberately steers the mount off a terrace, then asks it to ride back. Confirm normal input, grounded collision and fall recovery before deciding whether pose, camera or traversal state owns the fix. A recovery between sampled frames is not directly shown.

rows.subject: terrace edge clouds
rows.defect: Flat white polygonal cloud puffs cover the terrace cliff edge and read as loose foreground shapes against the continuous cloud floor
rows.notes: Deferred: The original strongest evidence is a deliberately off-terrace riding view. A normal flying arrival is still needed to choose a cloud treatment; island-mist geometry and the cloud deck are separate render paths. Owner: Cloudreach atmosphere/art lane. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-106/disposition.md. Original evidence: Strongest during mounted departure; compare normal flying arrival before selecting treatment.

rows.subject: riding camera over cloud void
rows.defect: One mounted traversal frame loses both trainer and deer and shows only the cloud floor
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude traversal-camera owner: one sampled deliberately off-edge riding frame cannot isolate camera behavior from fall/recovery state. Continuous production-input reproduction is required; camera logic is out of scope. Original evidence: Single sampled frame in deliberately off-edge fixture; confirm with continuous player camera before changing camera logic.

rows.subject: captain fight camera orientation
rows.defect: During incoming warnings the camera repeatedly faces an empty part of the arena or crops the opponent and ally so the attack direction and exchange are difficult to read
rows.notes: Deferred to Cloudreach gameplay/Claude camera owner: the live-input captain-fight evidence shows framing loss, but camera logic is excluded by CODEX_START_HERE section2c. Preserve the original manifest repro for the gameplay camera pass. Original evidence: Code-blind review of full three-opponent live-input Captain Veyra fight. Aeriex and Cloudfang leave the frame during incoming cues; a later reverse angle cuts off Cloudfang head and much of Sparkit. Distinct from Meadows P2-062 where the nearby ally fills and clips the view. The challenge and victory callbacks succeeded.

rows.subject: catch camera distance
rows.defect: Catch framing crowds the trainer and both creatures during aim then jumps close enough at strike and breakout to crop bodies and lose the orb path
rows.notes: Code-blind review of complete dry First Shore wild catch sequence. Cannonback, Terrapup and trainer overlap at aim distance; impact circle dominates Cannonback. The catch failure and success states are genuine pinned rolls, but a second same-species body may be in the scene. Stormwood Voltwig/Terrapup capture repeats the tight overlap and cropped strike; the dark ground makes the chance text more legible than Tidewake. Cloudreach repeats this with trainer across Skyrill face, a second body behind, then tight overhead contact. Code-blind review. Phase 2c disposition: blocked on gameplay camera owner tb/tidewake (shared with Cloudreach/Stormwood); aim/strike/breakout camera distance and collision staging are outside this presentation lane. Existing sightings remain evidence; no repair or PASS claimed. Final disposition: deferred to gameplay camera owner tb/tidewake (coordinate Cloudreach/Stormwood); catch aim/strike/breakout framing requires camera and collision staging outside Phase2 presentation scope. No fixed/PASS claim.

rows.subject: catch chance HUD contrast
rows.defect: The capture chance label and percentage sit over the trainer and pale grass with weak contrast, making the changing odds difficult to scan while aiming
rows.notes: The 4% to 41% values are visible on inspection, while the CAPTURE CHANCE label nearly disappears into the background. Assess on the actual 1920x1080 display before choosing a panel or text treatment. Cloudreach chance text crosses character models and pale sky with similarly weak contrast. Phase 2c: capture_readout_visual.json stages an outline for both percentage and caption using existing UI tokens; defaults off and preserves targeting/chance/choreography. Script check-only passes. Native paired Tidewake/Cloudreach sightings and blind review remain required.

rows.subject: catch chance feedback timing
rows.defect: A stale failed-catch message remains along the bottom while the new aim state shows 100% CAPTURE CHANCE and a nearly empty target bar
rows.notes: Deferred: The HUD gives its 1.8-second failed-catch message precedence over aiming; the capture forces the target to low HP for its second throw after a post-verdict wait. Normal-input timing evidence is needed before changing the message update rules. Owner: Shared combat/UI gameplay owner, with Cloudreach reproduction. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-117/disposition.md. Original evidence: Code-blind still-frame finding: bottom says not even close — weaken it first after the target has been weakened. Confirm duration in motion before choosing an update trigger.

rows.subject: full-party catch choice legibility
rows.defect: The full-party caught-creature choice panel leaves the earlier battle HUD visible through its transparent background and puts dim choice instructions at the screen bottom
rows.notes: Deferred: The catch-to-full-party panel transition needs a joint HUD-layer and instruction-contrast pass. A static frame cannot distinguish persistent layering from the transition; no paired presentation fix has been validated. Owner: Shared catch/menu UI lane, with Cloudreach reproduction. Evidence/next work: cloudreach/p2-118/disposition.md. Original evidence: Code-blind normal 1920x1080 capture. Full party is fixture context; this scores only overlapping layers and faint instructions. Selection mechanics are not inferred.

rows.subject: Fly carrier grip pose
rows.defect: The trainer hangs rigidly upright beneath Galecrest with raised straight arms and dangling legs, so the bird reads as perched on the hands rather than carrying a person
rows.notes: Code-blind comparison across three production-camera flight sequences. Meadows launch was reshot with a settled camera and clearly repeats the pose. The carrier silhouette is strong, but the body hold is unconvincing. Stormwood disclosed canopy fixture repeats the same hold; it does not establish campaign reachability.
